set.body:
Outcome

Run operator-native crossvalidated distance and RSA through partitioned relations, pairing design, measurement frame, and typed RDM estimands.

Acceptance

- Identity-precision distance and noise-whitened crossnobis are distinct.
- Pair order, scale, normalization, and precision provenance survive in results.
- Direct and materialized queries agree.
- One compatible relation fit serves RDM and RSA.
- JVM and Scala.js pass.
- This gate closes only after every P4B child closes.
set.title: P4B: prove the relational crossnobis and RSA vertical slice
